Sender SWC | Sender SWC application E2E Library Sender SWC RTE | Interface | CRC Library Sender E2E | Protection | Wrapper | Step S0: Application writes some values in each primitive element speed and accel of the complex data element AppDataEl. AppDataEl also contains primitive elements crc for CRC and counter for Counter, used for End-to-End Communication Protection. | Step S1: SWC invokes E2EPWrite_

_(..) instead of RTE_Write_

_(..), using the same parameters. | SWC interface wrapper converts the complex data element into an array which is identical to corresponding signal group mapped to an I-PDU. Bits unused between signals in the signal group in the I-PDU are filled with either 0 or 1. The array has the size of the signal group in the I-PDU. Note that what is outside the signal group (before and after signal group) is not included. | Step S3: SWC interface wrapper calls E2E_PXXProtect function, passing the data element configuration, state and serialized representation of the data element. | Step S4: E2E library executes protection, updates State and AppDataEl. | Step S5: Write protection information back to data element (CRC, Counter; DataIdNibble, if applicable). | Step S6: E2EPW calls RTE function to send the data element. | Step S8: Return value is returned to SWC. The value is composed of the return values of E2E_P01Protect (..) and Rte_Write (..). | Step S2: Serialize AppDataEl. | Step S7: E2EPW creates the return value and returns. | AppDataEl.speed = 250 | AppDataEl.accel = 1 | E2EPW_Write_
